manifest.description: Diagnose macro-generated Rust APIs or behavior that hide ownership, lifecycle, or public contracts callers must manually reason about.
when_to_use: proc-macro attributes or generated APIs are architectural boundaries
macro expansion uncertainty could invalidate a correction plan
a plan must isolate generated behavior or explicitly record macro-expansion uncertainty
anti_patterns: do not use for macro count alone
do not claim generated behavior was inspected unless cargo expand or equivalent evidence was used
do not use on non-Rust targets
